name: Chordia Food Products Limited
about: Chordia Food Products Limited engages in the food infrastructure and food business in India. It develops and leases infrastructure facilities, such as factories, processing unit, cold storages, warehouses, agri tech center, offices, etc. The company is also involved in manufacturing and processing of processed foods, vegetables, and makhana products. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
